description: Defines the DataObjects_Accounts class for managing account records, including creation, deletion, and linked user management in the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: DataObjects_Accounts
classes.description: Represents the 'accounts' table with methods for insertion, cascade deletion, and user management.

methods.name: staticGet
methods.description: Retrieves a static instance of the account object based on key-value pair.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new account record and sets admin account ID if applicable.

methods.name: deleteCascade
methods.description: Deletes referenced records and manages linked users.

methods.name: getAdminAccountId
methods.description: Returns the admin account ID from application variables.

methods.name: _auditEnabled
methods.description: Indicates auditing is enabled for this object.

methods.name: _getContextId
methods.description: Returns the account ID for context.

methods.name: _buildAuditArray
methods.description: Builds an audit array with account-specific details.

methods.name: _relinkOrDeleteUsers
methods.description: Handles linked user records during cascade delete, deleting or relinking users.
